sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single Scout returned one unified table across llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; most top rows were already published on latest origin/data, so the run pivoted within the same table to AgentCompass.

Main Agent read arXiv abstract, HTML, PDF, official GitHub README, runtime specs, analyzer docs, and implementation files; no required evidence images were needed because tables, formulas, and pseudocode preserved the claims.

Article explicitly separates infrastructure evidence from model-ranking claims, notes behavioral rather than causal reward-hacking labels, and states reproducibility limits for closed models and harness versions.
